why: The base shim floor pane _personal_feed_pane (cairn/tools/base/shim.py:578) projects EVERY personal-channel message to the device with no bound and no receipt filter; measured 2026-10-02 after the web server restart, GET /device/cairn returned 428,192,484 bytes, 434 MB of it under <h2>Chat (the 2,864 trouble->cairn replies among them). The page is unusable and each GET reads the whole channel.
